question: Data available publicly in the Financial Transparency System shows that entities belonging to the DT Global group received a total of EUR 130.78 million in funding from the Commission between 2018 and 2025 for the implementation of projects under the NDICI – Global Europe instrument1. On its website, DT Global lists numerous projects funded by the Commission carried out in various regions of the world2.

Publicly available registers do not contain detailed information regarding for which specific projects and in what exact amounts the above funds were allocated between 2018 and 2025. The company only publishes selected projects on its website, without specifying precisely under which EU financial instrument they were implemented or the amount of funding they received. In light of the above: 1.

Will the Commission make publicly available a full list of all projects implemented by DT Global and its affiliates under NDICI – Global Europe, setting out for each project: the project name, country or region of implementation, contract number, amount awarded in euros, implementation period and a brief description of the objectives?
Which of the projects listed by DT Global on their website were funded by NDICI – Global Europe and in what amounts?
Has the Commission carried out audits or evaluations of the effectiveness of the implementation of projects entrusted to DT Global under NDICI – Global Europe? If so, what were the main conclusions?
